Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anup Jairam Bhambhani
ORDER % 27.03.2026 CRL.M.A. 9183/2026 (exemption) Exemption granted, subject to just exceptions.
Let requisite compliances be made within 01 week.
The application stands disposed of.
By way of the present application filed under section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023 ('BNSS'), the appellant seeks exemption from filing lengthy synopsis and list of dates.
2. For the reasons stated in the application, which is duly supported by affidavit, the application is allowed.
3. The appellant is exempted from filing lengthy synopsis and list of dates.

4. The application is disposed-of.
5. By way of the present application filed under section 528 of the BNSS, the appellant seeks permission to file additional documents.
This is a digitally signed order.

sentences.text: 1 7. In view of the trial court record having been requisitioned, the present application is disposed-of as infructuous.
8. The appellant impugns judgment dated 26.12.2025 and sentencing order dated 12.01.2026.

9. Learned counsel appearing for the appellant submits, that the petitioner company was sentenced to a fine of Rs.25,00,000/- for the offences under sections 120-B/420 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860 ('IPC'); and to a fine of another sum of Rs.25,00,000/- for the offence under section 420 of IPC.

Counsel submits that as recorded in order dated 05.02.2026 passed by the learned trial court,
the entire fine of Rs.50,00,000/- has been deposited by way of two demand drafts.
10. Issue notice.
11. Ms. Tarannum Cheema, learned counsel appears for the respondent on advance copy; and accepts notice.

12. Let Trial Court Record be requisitioned in electronic form; let appeal paper-book be prepared;
and let a copy of the paper-book be supplied to both counsel on request.
13. Re-notify on 27th July 2026.
ANUP JAIRAM BHAMBHANI, J MARCH 27, 2026/ak
